bio: Although located away from the tourist section of the city, El Envero has fast developed a solid reputation and loyal clientele, who can dine to a backdrop of modern decor in the tapas bar, dining room and private section. The chef here has a passion for contemporary, seasonal cuisine (including daily specials and a media-ración option with some dishes) with a focus on organic produce from local vegetable gardens as well as different types of tuna. The name “Elvero” refers to the moment at which grapes change colour as they begin to ripen....
